title: Support access, and the screens for payment notices and the administrator's panel, pass CI on main
claim: Support access to one shop with owner visibility and a full audit (story S18.2, pull request 51) and the screens for payment notices and the administrator's panel (pull request 50) passed CI on main in the run for commit 92bf6c9; the run for the merge of pull request 50 alone was cancelled when the next merge superseded it. The screens were exercised against a fake server only
